edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender() and therefore controls the identity used by the owner check.
runPicker is protected by onlyOwner, which compares owner() against msg.sender-derived caller.
owner() and _msgSender() are compared inside the onlyOwner modifier.
block.timestamp is stored in blockTimeStamp to be reused as the picker seed.
block.timestamp feeds the unsafe pseudo-random seed operation.
The stored timestamp is passed into randomNum as the seed argument.
runPicker assigns block.timestamp to the blockTimeStamp state variable.
runPicker calls randomNum once per token index.
runPicker triggers the timestamp-seeded randomness that decides token assignment.
The value returned by randomNum is stored in the local variable random.
_BTS is packed into the keccak256 input producing num.
_tokenId is packed into the keccak256 input producing num.
random indexes tempAddresses to select the winning address.
random indexes tempAllowance to decrement the picked address allowance.
random selects the address key whose token list is appended to addressToTokenIds.
tokenIds[i] is pushed into the selected address entry of addressToTokenIds.
remove(random) is invoked when the picked address allowance reaches zero.
The index parameter determines where the deletion loop starts in remove.
index is used to shift the tempAddresses array during removal.
index is used to shift the tempAllowance array during removal.
remove pops the tail element of tempAddresses.
remove pops the tail element of tempAllowance.
_ad is used as the lookup key into addressToAllowance.
The loop counter i iterates the Addresses array in the constructor.
The loop counter i indexes the Allowances array in the constructor.
The loop counter i iterates tokenIds inside runPicker.
The constructor reads Addresses to initialise the working state.
The constructor reads Allowances to initialise the working state.
The constructor writes per-address allowances into addressToAllowance.
The constructor pushes initial allowances into tempAllowance.
The constructor pushes participant addresses into tempAddresses.
The inherited Ownable constructor calls _transferOwnership for the deployer.
runPicker sets the called latch to true at the end of execution.
transferOwnership delegates the storage update to _transferOwnership.
renounceOwnership delegates the storage update to _transferOwnership.
newOwner is written into the _owner state variable.
_transferOwnership assigns the new owner to _owner.
The previous owner is read from _owner before being overwritten.
getResults builds the in-memory results array.
Each result entry is filled from addressToTokenIds.
Each result entry records the address taken from Addresses.
getResults reads assignment data from addressToTokenIds.
getUsedTimestamp returns the stored blockTimeStamp seed.
getAllowanceForAddress reads the requested entry of addressToAllowance.

normalization_plan.reason: random is a temporary loop-local index inside runPicker and carries no standalone semantics.
num is the temporary hash result local to randomNum.
oldOwner is a scratch copy of _owner used only for the ownership event.
i is a plain loop counter whose behaviour is fully described by the loops of runPicker.
results is the in-memory return buffer local to getResults.
_BTS is the seed parameter consumed directly by randomNum.
_tokenId is the hash-mixing parameter consumed directly by randomNum.
_ad is the lookup parameter of getAllowanceForAddress.
index is the array position parameter of remove.
newOwner is the destination parameter ultimately written to _owner.
